IDQ20770
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Final Flood Warning for the Boyne and Burnett Rivers

Issued at 8:25 am AEST on Wednesday 4 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 2


FLOODING IS NO LONGER EXPECTED AT DUNOLLIE, MUNDUBBERA, AND GAYNDAH

Flooding is no longer expected along the Boyne and Burnett Rivers at Dunollie, Mundubbera,
and Gayndah. Thunderstorms remain possible during Wednesday but forecast rainfall totals
are not expected to significantly affect river levels.

Burnett River to Mundubbera:
Flooding is no longer expected along the Burnett River to Mundubbera.

The Burnett River at Mundubbera is currently at 5.52 m and steady, below the minor flood
level. The Burnett River at Mundubbera is expected to remain below the minor flood level
(7.00 m).

Stuart and Boyne Rivers:
Flooding is no longer expected along the Stuart and Boyne Rivers.

No observations are currently available for the Boyne River at Dunollie. The river level
is estimated to be below the minor flood level. The Boyne River at Dunollie is expected to
remain below the minor flood level (2.50 m).

Burnett River downstream of Mundubbera to Paradise Dam:
Flooding is no longer expected along the Burnett River downstream of Mundubbera to
Paradise Dam.

No observations are currently available for the Burnett River at Gayndah. The river level
is estimated to be below the minor flood level. The Burnett River at Gayndah is expected
to remain below the minor flood level (5.00 m).

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
This is a final warning. No further warnings will be issued for this event.
